clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked away high in the mountains above Hillsbrad Foothills, Ravenholdt Manor serves as the secluded headquarters for the guild of thieves and assassins known as Ravenholdt. Overseen by Lord Jorach Ravenholdt, the estate provides a discreet haven where practitioners of stealth hone their craft far from the eyes of authorities.

Hidden behind a narrow mountain pass and a winding cave northwest of Durnholde Keep, Ravenholdt Manor sits isolated on the borderlands of the Alterac Mountains. The property belongs to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt, a nobleman who maintains a disciplined enclave of rogues, assassins, and intelligence operatives. The grounds feature a tranquil garden and an outdoor training arena overseen by martial experts like Master Kang, providing a disciplined space to practice lockpicking, poison-crafting, and close-quarters combat. While the manor welcomes those with a talent for skullduggery, clumsy outsiders and unwanted visitors are treated with cold suspicion by the manor's watchful sentries.
